summary: Issue tracking and project planning tool for software teams.
access_note: Personal API keys from Security & access settings; OAuth2 apps created by users.

evidence.quote: Linear supports OAuth2 authentication, which is recommended if you're building applications to integrate with Linear.
For personal scripts API keys are the easiest way to access the API.
Visit Security & access settings to create and manage them.
It supports introspection so you can query the whole schema.
For all new setups, use the primary Streamable HTTP endpoint at https://mcp.linear.app/mcp.

notes: Free plan existence not verified from fetched page; GraphQL endpoint https://api.linear.app/graphql.
